raw_text: Always include full **type hints** (functions, methods, public attrs, constants). Prefer **pythonic** constructs; follow **SOLID**. Use descriptive naming; avoid single-letter identifiers except in tight math helpers. Keep code self-documenting; docstring public APIs/non-obvious rationale only. Raise specific exceptions; never `except:` bare; add actionable context. No wildcard imports; group stdlib/third-party/local. Favor pure functions; inject dependencies. Tests: `pytest`; keep the tests to a minimum; use parametrized tests when possible; do no add useless comments; the tests shall be self-explanatory. Fixtures avoid duplication; shared fixtures in `conftest.py`; use `tmp_path` for filesystem operations.
